EQ_CLIP_TOOLTIP: Output is clipping — lower band gains. Click to dismiss.
EQ_GRAPH_HINT: Click the curve to add a band, drag to move, scroll to change Q. Right click deletes.
EQ_VOLUME_COMPENSATION_TOOLTIP: Automatically lowers the output level to offset band boosts and prevent clipping.
INTERFACE_ALWAYS_SHOW_FORWARD_BUTTON_SUB: Keeps the Forward button visible next to Back instead of revealing it on hover.
INTERFACE_ALWAYS_SHOW_SCROLLBARS_SUBTEXT: Keeps scrollbars visible instead of hiding them automatically.
INTERFACE_FULL_WIDTH_LIBRARY_SUBTEXT: Allows the library to take up the full width of the screen.
INTERFACE_GRID_MIN_ITEM_WIDTH_SUBTEXT: Adjusts the minimum width of items in grid view.
INTERFACE_QUEUE_SELECT_ON_CLICK_SUBTEXT: Clicking on a queue item selects it, double clicking plays it.
INTERFACE_REDUCED_MOTION_SUBTEXT: Disables smooth scrolling, fades, and other motion-heavy UI animations.
INTERFACE_SLIM_SCROLLBARS_SUBTEXT: Use slimmer scrollbars for a cleaner visual style.
INTERFACE_STARTUP_LIBRARY_VIEW_SUBTEXT: Choose which library page opens when Hummingbird launches.
INTERFACE_THEME_SUBTEXT: Choose a built-in theme or add your own. Place custom theme files in the themes folder. Changes apply immediately.
INTERFACE_TWO_COLUMN_LIBRARY_SUBTEXT: Show navigation pages (like Artists) and content pages (like an album) side by side.
LANGUAGE_SUBTEXT: Select your preferred language for the application. Changes to the language will take effect after restarting the application.
PLAYBACK_CONSUME_SUBTEXT: Removes songs from the queue after they finish playing.
PLAYBACK_KEEP_CURRENT_ON_CLEAR: Keep current track when clearing queue
PLAYBACK_KEEP_CURRENT_ON_CLEAR_SUBTEXT: Preserves the currently playing song instead of removing all tracks.
PLAYBACK_PREVENT_IDLE_SUBTEXT: Stops the screensaver and system sleep during playback.
PLAYBACK_PREVIOUS_JUMPS: Previous button jumps to the beginning of the track if more than 5 seconds has elapsed
PLAYBACK_RG_FALLBACK_PREAMP_SUBTEXT: Applied when tracks have no ReplayGain data.
RELEASE_CHANNEL_SUBTEXT: Unstable builds are experimental and may contain bugs.
SCANNING_MISSING_DIALOG_BODY: One or more folders in your library are missing. What would you like to do with the items in those folders?
SCANNING_MISSING_DIALOG_DELETE_SUBTITLE: Remove the tracks and albums from the missing folder now. They will be removed from your library and playlists.
SCANNING_MISSING_DIALOG_DONT_ASK_HINT: You can change this later in Settings > Library.
SCANNING_MISSING_DIALOG_KEEP_SUBTITLE: Keep the missing albums and tracks. You won't be able to listen to them until the folder is returned or the device is reconnected, but they'll remain in your library and playlists.
SCANNING_MISSING_POLICY: When a configured folder is missing
SCANNING_MISSING_POLICY_SUBTEXT: Choose whether to ask, keep metadata, or remove tracks when a folder is unavailable.
SCANNING_RESCAN_REQUIRED: Your changes will be applied on your next scan.
SCANNING_SLOW_DISK_SUBTEXT: Reduce scanning threads to avoid thrashing on hard drives. Recommended when your music library is on a slow disk.
SCANNING_SUBTITLE: Changes apply on your next scan. Duplicate folders are ignored.
SCANNING_WATCH_CHANGES_SUBTEXT: Automatically update your library when files change on disk.
SCAN_WATCHING_TOOLTIP_BODY: Hummingbird is watching your files for updates and will automatically update the library when changes are made.
SCAN_WATCHING_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_HINT: You can disable this functionality in the library settings.
SERVICES_DISCORD_RPC_SUBTEXT: Shows the current track in your Discord status while music is playing.
SERVICES_LASTFM_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION: Finish signing in in your browser, then confirm here.
SERVICES_LASTFM_CONNECTED: Connected as {{name}}. Tracks will scrobble to Last.fm.
SERVICES_LASTFM_DISCONNECTED: Connect your Last.fm account to scrobble tracks.
SERVICES_LASTFM_ENABLED_SUBTEXT: Turn off to pause scrobbling without signing out.
SERVICES_LISTENBRAINZ_CONNECTED: Connected as {{name}}. Tracks will scrobble to ListenBrainz.
SERVICES_LISTENBRAINZ_DISCONNECTED: Enter your ListenBrainz user token to scrobble tracks.
SERVICES_LISTENBRAINZ_ENABLED_SUBTEXT: Turn off to pause scrobbling without signing out.
SERVICE_DELIVERY_CAPACITY: Playback updates exceeded this service's queue limit. Some updates were not delivered. Restart Hummingbird to resume reporting.
SERVICE_DELIVERY_STOPPED: A service stopped receiving playback updates. Check Services for details.
SERVICE_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: This service stopped processing playback updates. Restart Hummingbird to resume reporting.
SETTINGS_CORRUPT_DIALOG_BODY: Your settings file exists but couldn't be read. The scanner is paused to protect your library. Edit the file to fix it - the app will reload it automatically - or quit to investigate.
SETTINGS_CORRUPT_DIALOG_QUIT_SUBTITLE: Close the app without changing anything. Your settings file is preserved.
SETTINGS_CORRUPT_DIALOG_SHOW_SUBTITLE: Open the settings folder so you can edit the file. The app will reload automatically once it's valid.
SOURCE_ACCOUNT_SECRET: Enter the password or API key for the different account or library.
SOURCE_CACHE: Completed media cache budget in MiB
SOURCE_CACHE_BUDGET_PINNED: The cache budget is smaller than music kept offline or currently in use. Remove downloads or increase the budget.
SOURCE_CACHE_CLEAR_DEFERRED: Cached music removed. Files currently in use will be deleted when playback releases them.
SOURCE_CACHE_UNAVAILABLE: Downloaded music could not be loaded. Check storage access and close other Hummingbird instances.
SOURCE_CACHE_USAGE: Cached: {{cached}} MiB · Reserved: {{reserved}} MiB · Offline copies: {{copies}}
SOURCE_DIFFERENT_LIBRARY_NOTE: Create a separate library and disable the previous connection. Keep its tracks, playlists and downloads.
SOURCE_DOWNLOAD_QUEUE_FULL: The download queue is full. Wait for a download to finish or cancel one.
SOURCE_ERROR_AUTH: Sign in again or replace the saved credential.
SOURCE_ERROR_CANCELLED: The operation was cancelled or the connection changed. Refresh to retry.
SOURCE_ERROR_FORBIDDEN: This account does not have access to the requested music.
SOURCE_ERROR_INVALID: Check the server address, account, and settings. The server may have returned an invalid response.
SOURCE_ERROR_LIMIT: The request exceeded a resource limit. Choose fewer music folders or retry later.
SOURCE_ERROR_NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check the address and connection, then retry.
SOURCE_ERROR_NOT_FOUND: The server could not find the requested item. Refresh the library to retry.
SOURCE_ERROR_RATE_LIMIT: The server asked Hummingbird to wait before retrying.
SOURCE_ERROR_STORAGE: Changes could not be saved. Check available disk space and access to the library.
SOURCE_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED: This server or build does not support the requested feature.
SOURCE_EXCLUDE_LASTFM: Exclude this source from direct Last.fm scrobbling
SOURCE_EXCLUDE_LISTENBRAINZ: Exclude this source from direct ListenBrainz scrobbling
SOURCE_FOLDERS_SUBTITLE: Choose which server folders are added to your library.
SOURCE_FOLDER_REQUIRED: Select at least one folder, or disable the connection.
SOURCE_FORWARDING_NOTE: Some servers forward listens to Last.fm or ListenBrainz. Exclude direct forwarding below to avoid duplicates.
SOURCE_HTTP_WARNING: HTTP can expose account credentials and music to others on the network. Use HTTPS whenever possible.
SOURCE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: Choose whether this connection still uses the same account and library, or a different one.
SOURCE_INTERVAL: Automatic refresh interval in minutes (0 for manual only)
SOURCE_NEW_SECRET: Enter a new password or API key for this authentication method.
SOURCE_PURGE: Also purge this source’s indexed music and completed downloads
SOURCE_REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this connection? Indexed music and playlist references are retained unless you choose to purge them.
SOURCE_REPORTING: Send playback statistics to this server
SOURCE_SAME_LIBRARY_NOTE: Keep existing tracks when moving the server URL or rotating credentials.
SOURCE_SECRET: Password or API key (leave blank to keep the saved credential)
SOURCE_SECURE_STORAGE_FAILED: Secure credentials could not be saved. Unlock the credential store or explicitly choose session-only credentials.
SOURCE_SESSION_ONLY: Keep credentials for this session only
SOURCE_SINGLE_FOLDER: Tracks from {{folder}} will be added to your library.
SOURCE_TEST_CHANGED: The draft changed during the connection test. Test it again before choosing folders.
SOURCE_TEST_OK: Connection succeeded. Choose folders, then save.
SOURCE_URL: Server URL, including any proxy subpath
